expected.description: The Documents panel visibly includes a clear, usable filter row for file name, classification, and accounting month, while the existing status tabs remain available.
The filter labels use document fields supported by Nivo source: file_name, classification, period_key, and status.
The existing desktop layout, typography, blue palette, immutable ledger meaning, and unrelated panels remain visually intact.
The generated PNG is a polished desktop dashboard direction with readable controls and no invented operational claims.

prompts: Extend the supplied Nivo Accounting workbench desktop dashboard with a clearly usable document search/filter control. Use only fields supported by the Nivo accounting source: file name, classification, accounting month (period_key), and the existing status tabs. Preserve the current application layout, typography, blue palette, ledger's immutable/read-only meaning, and all unrelated panels.

notes: The backend accounting workbench query exposes document rows with file_name, classification, amount_minor, currency, period_key, status, context_version_id, context_digest, and context_snapshot. The existing status tabs already cover status, so the added row should focus on file-name search plus classification and month filters.

A narrow search of nivo-fe/apps/app/src and nivo-fe/packages found no matching Accounting workbench implementation or GraphQL operation; the bound baseline is therefore the visual source of truth for continuity, while nivo-backend is the source of truth for supported data fields.
This is a design artifact only; controls are visual specifications for later native implementation.

preserve: Preserve the full 1536 x 1024 desktop canvas and existing two-column Accounting workbench layout.
Preserve the existing application typography, white surfaces, fine gray borders, spacing system, and dark navy-to-blue action palette.
Preserve the Current ledger panel and its immutable snapshot (view-only) meaning, lock icon, ledger version controls, balance, and applied setup details.
Preserve the existing Documents status tabs and the three visible document rows with their current data and status badges.
Preserve Add evidence document, Reconciliation, Close period, Applied context, Pending corrections, Propose correction, and Accounting setup panels without changing their content or purpose.
change: Add one compact filter row inside the Documents panel between the existing status tabs and the document table.
Add a file-name search input labeled by placeholder text Search file name with a leading magnifying-glass icon.
Add a Classification select set to All classifications and an Accounting month select set to All months.
Add a small Clear filters action aligned with the filter controls so the reset behavior is discoverable.
Keep the filter controls visibly native, keyboard-friendly, and proportioned so the table remains easy to scan at the supplied desktop viewport.
